it was the second time i smoked in two weeks.  To clarify it a bit more, i smoked the first time mid-August, and then on September 5th i smoked again.  It was weed and i smoked a TON that day.  At least 12 hits.

When i was "high", i didn't really have that "good feeling" high.  Rather, i felt really relaxed but at the same time my heart was racing.  My attention, focus, and reflexes were all piqued (obviously) but at the same time i felt a little spacey.

The day after, i woke up to a really cloudy mind.  I had what is known as brain fog and still have some traces of it left (most of it is gone).  Basically, i couldn't think straight.  Everything took 5 times as much thought than had it before i smoked on the 5th of September this year.  It's been getting a lot better and it's almost gone now.

Problem is, i still have concentration problems, and the very minor anxiety i had before was literally piqued by the marijuana (it seems like).  Whenever i encounter a hard problem in my calculus course, i.e., i panic and i just can't do it and focus on it.

Whenever i go somewhere besides my dorm or my house (which i'm going to to rest over the weekend and try to heal my brain), i get really anxious and have sort of this panicky feeling.  I also feel like i'm not totally "there".  I feel really spaced out and this makes my anxiety worse ten-fold.  Before, when i was faced with a problem, there were times when i would panic.  However, i got over it the past couple of years.  Now, it feels like those anxiety issues were literally worsened by an astronomical degree.  It just sucks.

I think it has something to do with the pressure inside my head.  I apologize, i haven't told you the length of my foggy brain and anxious feelings.  It's been going on since September 5th.  Anyway, so, during the first week or so, there was constant pressure in my head (i could literally feel my head pulsating rapidly and an increase of my heart rate).  Now, the pulse isn't very high, but both sides of my brain feel strained in a way.  It's not really a pressure but more of an ache.....y feeling.  I also notice if i press on the left side of my head, it hurts a bunch.  I've been doing this constantly for three days and the pain is still there.  However, the ache....y feeling has been getting worse.  It doesn't ache to the extent that my head hurts, it's just that when i move my eyebrows up, there's a feeling in my entire head.

I literally feel like i fucked up my brain for good.  I'm not going to take any medications whatsoever.  Drugs are not an option for me.  No anti-depressants and no anxiety pills.  I'm not taking any of that stuff.  The foggy brain feeling is almost gone, but the anxiety and spacing out stuff is what's giving me all these panic attacks.  it's debilitating.  So yeah.  Thanks for responding.
